stable.notes: Nia Solari, Elara Vale and Rowan Vale now have eight-frame idle loops and four distinct combat stories each: 223 new authored frames with connected defense, strikes, Force moves, visible defeats and recovery. Each idle is scaled to its own combat art. Exact-stock older packs upgrade automatically; custom artwork, pose timing and scale, selected character, and saved global size/speed remain untouched. Versioned images land before the active map changes for safe retry. Miles Windu V15.4 and his 1.30x idle are unchanged. Includes 0.5.150 pet/panel polish: quiet IDLE hover controls and shared blur surfaces. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
